body.p: Exam: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
51-year-old man with right lower quadrant pain for 2 days, fever and leukocytosis. Rule out appendicitis.
Axial images from the lung bases to the pubic symphysis after 100 mL of intravenous Omnipaque 350.

The appendix is dilated to 12 mm with wall thickening and periappendiceal fat stranding. No abscess or free air. A 4 mm nonobstructing stone is present in the left kidney. The liver, spleen, pancreas and adrenal glands are normal.
1. Acute uncomplicated appendicitis. 2. Nonobstructing 4 mm left renal stone.
